summary: Test only: fractal-store's message-selector tests start from a fully folded seed. A commit folds for at most 10 ms of wall time, so on a loaded host the last seeded subject could still be pending, and the backfill-resume test took its expected pages below that subject's header. seed_backfill now folds what its commits left, which also makes the retired-headers test's own drain from #4163 unneeded.
